# DropSpace v0.3.0-beta.24 — Native Island and Beta migration

<!-- update-summary: Beta 24 rebuilds Native Island with four pages, immediate settings, eight widgets, improved lyrics and Apple Music audio. The prerelease channel is now Beta. Preview.23 users need a one-time manual installation; existing settings and data are preserved. -->

## Changes

- Widgets, Music, Files and Clipboard appear in that order with separate pages.
- Eight local widgets use a 4 by 8 grid; adding preserves existing positions and equal-size drag targets swap.
- Settings apply immediately without saved notices. English mode suppresses Chinese secondary lyric translations.
- NetEase is the default lyrics source, with bounded fallback to four other online sources. Apple Music timing and process audio capture are improved.
- New prereleases use Beta naming. Historical Preview tags, notes and assets remain unchanged.

## Upgrade compatibility

Preview.23 users must install Beta 24 once from the official website because the published Preview.23 parser cannot recognize Beta tags. Data and settings remain in place. Beta 24 supports both historical Preview and new Beta tags; future updates use numeric prerelease ordering, with Stable above the same release line.

## Known limits

This build requires x64 Windows build 20348 or later. NetEase on the tested host does not expose a valid system playback timeline; lyric progress is estimated and may be out of sync. Broader device, DPI and third-party provider behavior remains conditional on target evidence.

Official website: https://airanluo-dot.github.io/DropSpace/
